verdicts.label: A
verdicts.evidence: If gamma = 2, Sun Wukong can only add 2 walls per turn. The flood's perimeter grows as 8n. He can never enclose the flood even for a single initial cell, as the required perimeter grows much faster than his available walls.

verdicts.label: B
verdicts.evidence: If gamma > 8, Sun Wukong can build a large square loop around the initial flooded cells. By choosing the square large enough, he can complete the loop before the flood reaches the boundary. If gamma <= 8, the Sea God can choose an initial set of flooded cells large enough that Sun Wukong can never 'catch up' to the expanding perimeter of the flood.
